intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The tutoring center, after hours. Monty has made two cups of tea and opened the Python REPL.

hello.speaker: python
hello.text: I want to show you something. Type import this, and Python reads you a little poem about itself. It's called the Zen of Python.

zen.speaker: python
zen.text: "Readability counts." That one's my favorite. Python's also relaxed about types: one variable can hold a number, and then a string.

passed.speaker: python
passed.text: See? The variable didn't mind changing. ...Simple is better than complex. I've been thinking that a lot lately. About us studying together, I mean.

failed.speaker: python
failed.text: Hm, not quite. Readability counts, so let's read it again together.

bye.speaker: python
bye.text: The tea will still be warm. Probably.
